latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Adjust button flex class for correct sizing on mobile by @Sartoric in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/685
* schema: rewrite profile.json as self-documenting prescriptive contract by @thetimetraveler in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/666
* fix: assorted reliability fixes by @thetimetraveler in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/678
* DDSA & Statistics: Compare and Improvements by @modsmthng in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/659
* fix: Split Kff out of PID after save round-trip by @crwper in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/687
* Drag-and-drop reordering and improved tooltip handling in ProfileList by @Sartoric in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/646
* Feature/startup profile configuration by @vinca in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/626
* feat(scales): expose battery in /api/scales/info, evt:status, and Scales UI by @thetimetraveler in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/682
* fix(predictive): evict samples older than windowDuration by @thetimetraveler in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/679
* fix: Improve Dashboard responsive layout by @xishec in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/512
* Web UI expand/collapse navigation by @modsmthng in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/660
* feat: Dashboard improvements by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/703
* feat(autotune): SIMC integrator+lag rule + exp-peeling τ₂ (fixes #672) by @salekseev in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/683
* fix(profile-import): repair Decent (TCL) profile converter by @FR4NKLN in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/708
* feat(profile-import): add Meticulous JSON profile importer by @FR4NKLN in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/709
* perf+fix(firmware/web): profile reliability, response handling, BLE/WiFi coexistence, browser compat by @FR4NKLN in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/710
* SonarQube fix: Restrict write access to release job by @LeonHuzen in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/719
* feat: add Flush as a button behavior option by @FR4NKLN in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/720
* fix(firmware): mDNS responder reconnect leak — restore `.local` resolution by @FR4NKLN in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/717
* fix(firmware): local-capture lastProcess/currentProcess in onVolumetr… by @FR4NKLN in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/714
* fix(firmware): reset Profile copies before parseProfile-append callers by @FR4NKLN in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/713
* Framed nanopb TX/RX comms protocol (replaces NimBLEComm) [GM-82] by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/726
* ci(pr-flash): only deploy PR preview for repo owner's PRs (GM-85) by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/729
* feat(display): route remaining JsonDocuments to PSRAM (GM-7) by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/723
* feat(display): back WebSocket rxBuffers with PSRAM (GM-8) by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/724
* feat(display): allocate ShotHistory ioBuffer in PSRAM (GM-9) by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/722
* Recover from an incompatible controller via OTA (treat as protocol mismatch) [GM-82] by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/730
* fix(comms): drive all LED channels in one message [GM-86] by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/731
* feat(display): show protocol-version mismatch on standby screen [GM-87] by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/732
* perf(web): serve content-hashed assets with immutable cache headers [GM-83] by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/733
* Rewrite several loop methods to tasks by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/gaggimate/pull/696
* fix(comms): stop BLE client connecting to bogus addresses (GM-89) by @jniebuhr in https://github.com/jniebuhr/

[![](https://dcbadge.vercel.app/api/server/APw7rgPGPf)](https://discord.gg/APw7rgPGPf) [![CC BY-NC-SA 4.0][cc-by-nc-sa-shield]][cc-by-nc-sa] [![Sonar QG][sonar-shield]][sonar-url] [![Sonar Violations][sonar-violations]][sonar-url] [![Sonar Tech Debt][sonar-tech-debt]][sonar-url]

This project upgrades a Gaggia espresso machine with smart controls to improve your coffee-making experience. By adding a display and custom electronics, you can monitor and control the machine more easily. ## Features - **Temperature Control**: Monitor the boiler temperature to ensure optimal brewing conditions. - **Brew timer**: Set a target duration and run the brewing for the specific time. - **Steam and Hot Water mode**: Control the pump and valve to run the respective task. - **Safety Features**: Automatic shutoff if the system becomes unresponsive or overheats. - **User Interface**: Simple, intuitive display to control and monitor the machine. ## Screenshots and Images ### How to buy You can buy your kit on https://shop.gaggimate.eu/ ## How It Works The display allows you to control the espresso machine and see live temperature updates. If the machine becomes unresponsive or the temperature goes too high, it will automatically turn off for safety. ## Docs The docs were moved to [https://gaggimate.eu/](https://gaggimate.eu/). You can find all sourcing and assembly information there. Additional documentation for the WebSocket API can be found in [docs/websocket-api.yaml](docs/websocket-api.yaml). ## Hardware Files The hardware files were moved to [gaggimate/parts](https://github.com/gaggimate/parts). ## License This work is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
